name: bws-direction
description: Drift detection: after a turn that edits files, Sonnet checks the work against the session's opening request (reading the whole conversation), its run-folder PLAN.md and the project's docs/ corpus (specs, PRD, requirements, architecture or design docs first; a GDD for a game) and says aligned, drifting or off course, and whether the agent wandered or the scope was widened. Verdicts are kept per project, so the Direction tab of the dashboard shows drift within the session and across sessions; /direction overall judges recent commits as a whole.

autoCheck.title: Check turns automatically
autoCheck.description: Check each turn that edits a file or makes 3+ tool calls when it ends (interactive sessions only). Off: only /direction check runs one.

every.title: Check every Nth working turn
every.description: 1 checks every working turn; 3 checks every third one.

model.title: Turn-check model
model.description: Model alias or id that judges a turn (haiku, sonnet, opus, or a full id).

overallModel.title: Whole-project model
overallModel.description: Model alias or id for /direction overall, which reads recent commits and earlier verdicts.

docsDir.title: Docs folder
docsDir.description: The project's document corpus, relative to the project folder. Every .md under it is read (4 levels, 300 files).

anchorDocs.title: Anchor documents
anchorDocs.description: Paths relative to the project, comma-separated, whose outline every check reads. Empty: found by name in the docs folder: PRD, spec, requirements, design doc, GDD or vision first, then architecture, technical design or *-spec (the shallowest ones, at most 3).

nudge.title: Tell Claude about drift
nudge.description: While this session's last check found drift, Claude's context carries the verdict as a warning: it keeps working and mentions the drift in one line.
